answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can be grounded in proof-of-personhood attestations woven into a trust trellis, where each new identity must bond stake to a verified human anchor before it may wander across market segments. Anchors are seeded through a cedar-rooted registry of hardware-backed credentials, so colluding agents cannot cheaply replicate the endorsement. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
